name: fn2
description: Answer public-markets questions with FN2 AI data, read directly (earnings vs consensus, earnings-call transcripts, SEC financials, prices, FRED), and start, monitor, and schedule FN2 AI autonomous research agents from your terminal assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Read earnings data and run FN2 AI market research agents
interface.longDescription: Drive the public fn2.ai API. Read market data directly: reported earnings against analyst consensus, earnings-call transcripts and search, SEC-filing financials, prices, FRED series, and your account's saved notes. Or start research agents, check their status and latest results, and schedule them on a cadence such as 'before the next market open'. Dependency-free Python 3 helper; connects via a browser device-authorization flow (fn2.ai/start) with a scoped, revocable credential.
defaultPrompt: Use $fn2 to summarize Netflix's most recent earnings report and call.
Use $fn2 to show the status of my fn2 agents.
Use $fn2 to schedule a pre-market brief on my watchlist before the next market open.
